assumptions.statement: Author-declared inertial-frame premise: uniform straight-line train motion, V>0 along positive x, and light-signal-synchronized local clocks assigning event times in each frame. Equal train-frame strike times are distinct from equal visual arrival times. No observer position or light-travel distance is invented.

Author-declared constant-specific-heat approximation for liquid water over the interval; unchanged quantity, no phase change, whole system at rest, negligible heat loss and expansion work. DeltaU approximately m_water*c_water*DeltaT. Use retained internal energy, not all supplied heat, when external work is significant.
Optional usual textbook approximation c_water approximately 4.2e3 J/(kg K). The selected source does not supply this material constant; the primary result is symbolic.
